log_system_info: log system information including hostname, platform, CPU count, memory, and GPU device properties to the info log
log_software_info: log software version information for Python, PyTorch, CUDA, NCCL, fairseq2, and fairseq2n to the info log
log_environment_variables: log all environment variables excluding BASH_FUNC and color-related variables to the info log
log_model: log a PyTorch model's parameter count, trainable parameters, buffer size, and total size in bytes to the info log
log_tokenizer: log a tokenizer's vocabulary size and special token indices including UNK, BOS, EOS, PAD, BOH, and EOH
